<p><a name="module_RTKRecording"></a></p>
<p>The RTKRecording module represents the state of the current recording, and allows
to start/stop recordings and check if there's a recording in progress.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#module_RTKRecording">RTKRecording</a>
<ul>
<li><a href="#module_RTKRecording+start">.start()</a></li>
<li><a href="#module_RTKRecording+stop">.stop()</a></li>
<li><a href="#module_RTKRecording+pause">.pause()</a></li>
<li><a href="#module_RTKRecording+resume">.resume()</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><a name="module_RTKRecording+start"></a></p>
<h3 id="meeting-recording-start">meeting.recording.start()</h3>
Starts recording the meeting.
<p><strong>Kind</strong>: instance method of <a href="#module_RTKRecording"><code>RTKRecording</code></a><br />
<a name="module_RTKRecording+stop"></a></p>
<h3 id="meeting-recording-stop">meeting.recording.stop()</h3>
Stops all recording currently in 'RECORDING' state
<p><strong>Kind</strong>: instance method of <a href="#module_RTKRecording"><code>RTKRecording</code></a><br />
<a name="module_RTKRecording+pause"></a></p>
<h3 id="meeting-recording-pause">meeting.recording.pause()</h3>
Pauses all recording currently in 'RECORDING' state
<p><strong>Kind</strong>: instance method of <a href="#module_RTKRecording"><code>RTKRecording</code></a><br />
<a name="module_RTKRecording+resume"></a></p>
<h3 id="meeting-recording-resume">meeting.recording.resume()</h3>
Resumes all recording currently in 'PAUSED' state
<p><strong>Kind</strong>: instance method of <a href="#module_RTKRecording"><code>RTKRecording</code></a></p>
